svg.title: Yashaswin Puranik Sharma
svg.desc: Yashaswin Puranik Sharma. Systems from the kernel up, and a probe that reads them. A drawing of six thin plates floating one above the other, from the bottom up: kernels, tensors, autograd, attention, model, and on top the residual stream, the only plate in colour. Small points of light rise through the plates. A thin probe needle rests in the residual stream and a short read-out trace draws beside it.
